items.title: Chapter NS's toc_inventory.json carries severe two-column TOC OCR corruption (32/47 nodes LOW/MEDIUM packet-confidence, plus 4 section-level nodes NS.S16-S19 with titles that are pure OCR noise unrelated to their actual body content); resolved via direct page-image review rather than OCR text re-parsing
items.summary: Resolved by rendering the chapter's real TOC page (pdf 933) and 7 body pages (pdf 934, 936, 939, 940, 941, 944, 977) to PNG via pdftoppm and visually reading them, following the same methodology established for chapter N. Corruption patterns found: (1) genuine headings with a bled fragment of a distant unrelated heading appended (e.g. NS.S02.T05 'Elevated ICP Persistent Vegetative State'); (2) a genuine heading split across two sibling T-nodes by a column break (NS.S10.T01/T02, AVM/cavernoma/dural AVF); (3) spurious extra T-nodes with no matching body content at their assigned page location, whose real content lives elsewhere in the chapter (NS.S02.T01 'Head Injury', NS.S03.T02 'Intraventricular Hemorrhage', NS.S04.T01 'Craniosynostosis'); (4) four section-level nodes (NS.S16-S19) whose titles are column-bleed duplicates of the CNS Tumours subtopic names from an unrelated page, while their real body content (confirmed via page-image review) is Functional Neurosurgery, Surgical Management of Epilepsy, Surgical Management of Trigeminal Neuralgia, and Landmark Neurosurgery Trials respectively. See study_units.json's methodology_note for full detail. No content was invented from neurosurgical background knowledge; every correction traces to a rendered page image, the packet's merged_duplicate_headings field, or the real chapter TOC. One organizational heading (INTRACRANIAL PATHOLOGY, NS4) remains genuinely UNRESOLVED per the packet's own source_quality.unresolved_headings entry and is recorded as such rather than guessed.
items.recommended_action: Coordinator should consider a TOC-extraction pipeline fix for two-column layouts (as previously recommended for chapter N) given this is now a second chapter exhibiting the identical column-bleed failure mode; no action needed on this chapter's own study units beyond the semantic spot-checks below.

items.summary: The packet's source_quality.unresolved_headings records 'INTRACRANIAL PATHOLOGY' as UNRESOLVED (TOC page-number digits did not parse to a page consistent with reading order, and no body-page line matched within the search window pdf934-944). This is a non-clinical section-divider heading (confirmed via body-page review at pdf936, where it precedes 'Intracranial Pressure Dynamics'); it carries no independent clinical content and is excluded from study units, consistent with treatment of 'EXTRACRANIAL PATHOLOGY' and 'SPECIALTY TOPICS'.
items.recommended_action: No action required; documented for traceability per project instruction to use explicit UNRESOLVED rather than guess.
